transcript.content: Hi, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I came because I’ve been feeling uneasy. Even when I’m having a decent day, I can’t quite shake the feeling that some people at church, and in my walking club, are watching me. Like they put little messages about me in the bulletin, or in things they say. It’s… hard to explain.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep than usual?
Not really… I don’t think so. My sleep isn’t perfect, but I wouldn’t say I’ve had times where I felt especially energized like that.
Have you heard voices when no one else was there?

Sometimes… yes. When the house is quiet, I’ll hear my name, or just a few words. It sounds like my friend’s voice, maybe from the kitchen or the porch. Clear enough that I’ve answered before I remember nobody’s there.
Have you had any recent medical illness or injury to your head?
No… not that I can think of. I haven’t had any head injury or anything recent like that.
Do you ever feel like thoughts are being put into your mind by someone or something outside of you?

I don’t know if I’d say thoughts are put in my mind exactly… but I do get this feeling that people at church, or in my walking club, are sort of watching me. Like there are little messages about me in the bulletin, or in things they say. I try not to make too much of it, but it’s hard to shake.
Have you found yourself becoming much less interested in seeing people or doing things you used to enjoy?

Yes… I guess so. I used to like tending my garden, quilting, reading a little before bed. Lately I just… don’t bother much. The quilt basket sits there, and the weeds can grow, and I don’t seem to care like I used to.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or doesn’t make sense?

Sometimes, yes. People have said I jump around… like I’ll start talking about the mail or church, and then somehow I’m on quilt patterns or birds, or… warnings. I can see on their faces they don’t really know what I’m getting at.
Have these experiences been going on for longer than one month?
Yes… longer than a month. It started not too long after my close friend died… about a year and five months ago, I think.
During this time, have you had a period of at least several days when you felt deeply depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yes… it’s been more than just a few days. The sadness and guilt, and not wanting to do much of anything… that’s been there about a year and a couple months now.
Have there been at least two weeks when you were hearing voices or felt people were sending you messages, but you were not feeling depressed during that time?

Yes… I think so. There were a few weeks where I wasn’t feeling so weighed down. I was getting dressed, eating a little better… but I still heard my name in the house sometimes, and I thought people at church were hinting things about me.
Have these problems been going on continuously for at least six months?
Yes… it’s been going on longer than that. Since not long after my close friend died… about a year and five months ago.
For most of the time these problems have been going on, have you also been feeling depressed?
Yes… most of the time, I think. Even when the other things weren’t as strong, that sadness and guilt were still kind of there… and I didn’t really feel interested in much.
